latHint: Think what a student does with each letter of a tricky word.
pivHint: A CHARM is a tiny trinket that dangles from a bracelet. It is also a magical incantation that a wizard might cast - a ______.
winText: Magic words. CHARM was the pivot - a bracelet trinket to a SPELL.
lossText: SPELL - magic words that cast an enchantment. CHARM was the pivot: a CHARM is a small trinket on a bracelet, but in fairy tales a CHARM is also a magical incantation, a SPELL.
